oracle independence: opa parse (OPA 1.18.2) shares no code with the reader (internal/extractor/regoextract.go, no dependency), so this tier-A reading proves the parse as well as the mapping; had OPA's own parser been the extractor (ADR-048's wave-pc amendment, option a) the oracle would have proven only the mapping from its AST

open-policy-agent/opa is measured on the 138 .rego files OPA 1.18.2 accepts (the -only list), of which discovery reads 126; the 43 it rejects (v0-syntax formatter fixtures, documentation examples written to fail) have no oracle and are not scored: the reader reads them without a fault or a repair
the reader needed no repair (an unclosed bracket or string, a stray closer; extractor.RegoRepairs) on any of the 370 files OPA accepts in the two subjects, nor on the 43 it rejects

names compare whole (name_match identity): a package path may hold a hyphenated segment (regal.rules.bugs.annotation-without-metadata) that bare matching cuts on fathom's side only, and the oracle names a call's caller by its rule's full name, as its definition (O381)

file_edge_recall is capped by the truth's shape (LB-F57): an import of a package split across files names every file of it (regal's data.regal.ast is six files with 160 importers) while an edge reaches the file defining the rule used (O383); 3 of open-policy-agent/opa's 4 pairs outside the truth are a SymbolKey two files of one directory share (O382)
